nl: In cmd/server/main.go, replace the exact text `http.ListenAndServe(":8080", mux)` with `http.ListenAndServe(":9090", mux)`. Change nothing else.
oracle_program: replace "http.ListenAndServe(\":8080\", mux)" "http.ListenAndServe(\":9090\", mux)" in: ["cmd/server/main.go"] mode: literal expect: 1
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('cmd/server/main.go')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = 'http.ListenAndServe(":8080", mux)'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, 'http.ListenAndServe(":9090", mux)').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
